items.title: Troubleshooting 440R-ENETR Relay Configuration Faults | IMD
items.summary:
Read the interface's hardware series from its identification information or label. The Guardmaster EtherNet/IP Network Interface User Manual, publication 440R-UM009E-EN-P, February 2026, explains that Series B, introduced in mid-2018, removed the embedded webpage. A Series B unit can therefore communicate normally without presenting a browser page.

`001`
`192.168.1.1`
`255.255.255.0`
`192.168.1.5`
`0.0.0.0` [...] `16#0009`

The recorded module information also shows `Major Fault: None`, `Minor Fault: None`, and `Configured: Configured`. Those fields do not cancel the connection rejection. Read them alongside `Internal State: Unconnected`, `Owned: No`, and the actual connection fault.

`Major Fault: None`
`Minor Fault: None`
`Configured: Configured`
`Internal State: Unconnected`
`Owned: No`

## Separate the missing webpage from Ethernet reachability [...] | Observed symptom | What it tells you | Next check |
 --- 
| Ping works and RSLinx reads identity | IP communication and device identification work; the controller's cyclic connection is a separate transaction. | Read the configuration fault and compare the relay stack. |
| Browser cannot open the interface | On Series B, the embedded webpage was removed. | Read the hardware series before troubleshooting HTTP access. |
